    • fromString

      public static Vendor fromString(String value)

      The API returns two different wire forms for a vendor: the display form used by VirtualDeviceType.vendor (e.g. "Palo Alto Networks") and the uppercase code form used by VirtualDeviceDetailsResponse.deviceTypeVendor (e.g. "PALO_ALTO_NETWORKS"). Both are accepted here; unrecognised values map to UNKNOWN.
